yanked_versions.0.7.0: broken: unfetchable in two independent layers. This registry entry named https://github.com/savvifi/aion/releases/download/aion-toolchain-v0.7.0/rules_aion-0.7.0.tar.gz, and savvifi/aion is PRIVATE, where that friendly releases/download form returns a flat 404 with zero redirects — with or without a bearer token that can read the repo. Fixing only the URL is not enough: 0.7.0's own aion_toolchain/repository.bzl omits `type` in download_and_extract, so the toolchain artifact then downloads, verifies integrity, and fails extraction with "Expected a file with a .tar.gz suffix" — which reads like a corrupt artifact rather than a missing argument. Both are fixed in 0.7.1, published under the api.github.com asset endpoint with archive_type set. Use 0.7.1.
